ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and peduncle-proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized, bilaterally symmetric low-intensity (black) mass extending from the peduncle into the inner lobes. Transition zones exhibit high-frequency mottling. Lateral fluke lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity (white) pixels with scattered low-intensity speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is higher toward the distal tips. Presence of distinct jagged valleys along the right lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the trailing edge, tapering to narrow, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast globular pixel clusters (off-white/grey) localized specifically at the extreme distal tips (corners) of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, dark-intensity horizontal linear marking located on the lower-quadrant of the left lobe; multiple fine, vertical/diagonal dark-pixel disruptions scattered across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch (indentation) on the upper-right trailing edge, distinct from regular serration. Small U-shaped gouge visible on the inner-left trailing edge near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, thick, dark-intensity arc-shaped linear feature located on the mid-left lobe.
